items.title: Lillie Delk Christian Interview, 1961-04-25
items.q: And Manson Kara happened to be on banjo for that date.

ctx.x: Then Louie Armstrong finally with Jimmy Noon, Earl Hines, Manson, Manson. Uh huh. Now this was uh. Oh this may have been the summer. No this was after the summer I believe. The summer that Earl Hines joined Jimmy Noon. You know. And Manson Kara happened to be on banjo for that date. Did Johnny Sincere still have something to do with it you think?
